figures.title: Structural relaxation of a two-domain structure in (PbTiO3)n/(SrTiO3)n superlattices.
Optimization of the lateral size of a two-domain structure in (PbTiO3)n/(SrTiO3)n superlattices.

(a) Force-constant bands along Γ-X obtained after diagonalization of the force-constant matrix in a (PbTiO3)9/(SrTiO3)9 supercell. (b) Relaxed structure following the strongest instability of the force-constant bands.
Energy profile per five atom unit cell as a function of the lateral size of the supercell for the two- (solid dots) and four- (open dots) domain structures.
Polarization map of the relaxed structures labeled from 1 to 4 in Fig. 4 for different lateral sizes L and a layer thickness of n = 12.

Polarization map for a n = 14, L = 28 supercell at finite temperature (T = 90 K) and compressive epitaxial strain of −0.5%. (a) Initial two-domain structure configuration. (b) Temporal evolution obtained by molecular dynamics simulations at finite temperature.
